documents.title: Development Application Public Notice
documents.content:
1. **Construction of a new refrigerated warehouse addition** to the west of the existing building envelope, comprising approximately 8,750 square metres of additional floor area. The addition will be constructed with insulated metal cladding and a standing-seam roof profile, finished in Colorbond® Monument and Woodland Grey to match the existing structures.

2. **Installation of a new ammonia refrigeration plant room** (approximately 450 square metres) located at the north-western corner of the site, housing low-charge ammonia systems. The plant room will include a 12-metre-high vent stack and acoustic attenuation enclosures.

3. **Reconfiguration of the existing truck staging area** to increase the number of loading docks from 14 to 24, including the addition of a dedicated freezer dock with a temperature-controlled dock shelter.

4. **Construction of a new 3,200 square metre hardstand area** for heavy vehicle parking and manoeuvring, surfaced with asphalt, with a bunded stormwater detention basin (capacity 1,150 cubic metres) to the south of the hardstand.

5. **Upgrade of the existing site access** from Georgian Way, including a new signalised intersection, a dedicated right-turn lane, and a 3.0-metre-wide shared path connection to the existing Bayswater Foreshore path network.

6. **Landscaping and screening works**, including a 4.5-metre-high acoustic barrier along the northern boundary adjoining residential lots on Watsonia Street, and a 12-metre-deep vegetated buffer along Collier Road.

**Existing Operations**

The Bayswater Cold Storage Facility currently operates as a multi-temperature cold chain logistics hub, providing storage and distribution services for frozen and chilled food products, pharmaceuticals, and temperature-sensitive freight for the Perth metropolitan region. The facility operates 24 hours per day, seven days per week, with peak activity between 6:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

The Bayswater Cold Storage Facility current_capacity_tonnes is 4500 tonnes. Record status: current. This current figure reflects the total palletised storage capacity across all temperature zones (ambient, chilled, and frozen) and is the capacity figure used for all planning and environmental assessments supporting this application.

**Operational Details of the Proposed Expansion**

| Item | Existing | Proposed (Post-Development) |
|---|---|---|
| Total warehouse floor area | 12,400 m² | 21,150 m² |
| Number of loading docks | 14 | 24 |
| Truck movements per day (heavy vehicles) | 86 | 142 |
